topic.title: Media Search
topic.shortdesc: Use the Media tab search for available media resources (images, audio, video) and insert references to them.

body.p: The Media tab within the Workspace Search view allows you to see all media resources (images, video, audio) defined in particular folders from your project. You can insert references to those media resources or open them in the editor.
The Media tab contains the following options and features:

dlentry.dd: Use this field to specify project folders to be searched for media (image, audio, video) resources. Changes made to this list are stored in the user's local browser settings.
Use this field to filter the list of resources by typing part of the file name.

Each found media resource (images, audio, video) is displayed in a card. While hovering over a media result, additional actions become available in top-right corner of the result, depending on the resource type:
Open in editor - Opens the resource in the visual editor.
Insert media reference - Inserts a reference to the particular image/video/audio resource in the current document. If there is a DITA key defined for the particular resource, the resource is referenced with a key reference.
Insert figure reference - Inserts a figure element with the particular image/video/audio resource referenced inside the figure within the current document. If there is a DITA key defined for the particular resource, the resource is referenced with a key reference.
